title: ervum cassubicum
intro: Ervum cassubicum, commonly known as vetch or hairy vetch, is a perennial legume plant native to Europe and Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, improve digestion, and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Ervum cassubicum include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
